answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. A ripple of per-task receipts records who did what, and the orchard of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, capped per identity per epoch, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the falcon of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
